sources.note: Nothing. p.371 sec.1 'Alphabet' lists letters only; sec.2 'Sounds. I have no information as to sounds in Tasiriki, but ' probably represents [gamma], the 'Melanesian g.'' (verified on page image). No accent/stress/syllable remark anywhere in the 13-page sketch (compiled from F.G. Bowie's 1909-1924 scripture translations).

sources.citation: Taman, Allan, Sabrina Taman & Tihomir Rangelov. 2025. Language ecosystems in Western Santo. Te Reo 68(2) (special issue 'Vanuatu languages in context'): 186-245.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sociolinguistic/ecology survey; Akei paragraph (speaker counts, villages, 'a lot of internal dialectal variation'); no phonology. Cites Rangelov 2025 COOL13 talk on Western Santo 'phonological history' and Rangelov (in prep.).

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Akei language' (wikitext downloaded via API, rev. 2024-12); Grambank akei1237 language page
sources.note: Wikipedia 'Phonology' section reproduces Ray's 1926 letter inventory and notes the phonetic values are uncertain; nothing on stress. Grambank codes akei1237 from Ray 1926 only.
